day_local: Khamiista Toddobaadka 31-aad ee Wakhtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka qof si taxaddar leh u raadinaya shay yar oo ka lumay gurigiisa. Waa saacad dambe, iftiinku wuu yaraa, laakiin qofku wuu shiday laambad, wuu bilaabay inuu xaaqo dhulka, wuxuu eegayaa gees walba. Waa hawl u baahan dulqaad iyo feejignaan. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Ilaah uu yahay sida haweeneydaas oo kale, ama sida adhijirka ka taga sagaashan iyo sagaalka neef si uu u helo midka lumay. Waa raadin aan daalin, waa jacayl aan marnaba quusan.

Waxaan maanta ka fikireynaa Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil nolosha u arkaayay sida qorshe weyn oo u baahan in la darsado, laga fikiro, oo la fahmo. Waxaan ognahay inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin xusuusiyo hal shay oo ka mid ah nolosha Ben oo muujinaysa inuu fahmay 'qiimaha' waxa lumay. Xusuuso markii uu ahaa 15 jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa oo dhan si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu uu had iyo jeer u furnaa dadka kale, isagoo garanaya in jacaylku uu yahay waxa ugu qaalisan ee aynu haysano.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Laakiin wax kasta oo aan u haystay faa'iido, waxaan u arkay khasaare Masiixa aawadiis.' Bawlos wuxuu ogaaday in aqoonta Masiixu ay ka qiimo badan tahay wax kasta oo kale. Ben, in kasta oo uu ahaa wiil caqli badan oo diiradda saarayay sayniska iyo tiknoolajiyadda, haddana wuxuu ahaa wiil si qoto dheer u aaminsanaa jacaylka. Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo ka dhergay jacaylka Ilaah. Waxaan xusuustaa riyadii aad la wadaagteen, markii Ben uu ku yiri: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Wuxuu gudbay imtixaankii nolosha si kaamil ah. Wuxuu hadda joogaa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo nabad qaba.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida kursiga uu qof kasta u tartamayo, Ben wuxuu doorbiday inuu noqdo mid fudud, mid jecel, oo mid naftiisa u hura dadka kale. Jacaylka uu kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda ku siiyo. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan ku soo dhoweynayaa sidii adigoo horey ii dhex jooga, waxaana naftayda kuu dhiibayaa gebi ahaanba. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhowro, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Nabadda Masiixa ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku dejiyo iftiinka wejigiisa oo uu siiyo nabad weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, in Ilaah uu u soo dejiyo raaxo, xoog, iyo rajo ay ku sii wadaan nolosha iyagoo isku hallaynaya jacaylkiisa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Annagu waxaan nahay kuwa gudanaya gudniinka runta ah, annaga oo Ilaah ku caabudaya Ruuxa, oo ku faanaya Ciise Masiix, oo aan ku kalsoonayn jidhka. Inkasta oo aan aniguba aan haysto sabab aan ugu kalsoonaado jidhka. Haddii qof kale u maleeyo inuu ku kalsoon yahay jidhka, anigu aad ayaan uga sii kalsoonahay. Waxaa lay gudaa maalintii siddeedaad, waxaan ka mid ahay qowmiyadda Israa'iil, qabiilka Benyaamiin, waxaan ahay Cibraani ka dhashay Cibraaniyiin, xagga sharcigana waxaan ahaa Fariisi. Xagga dadaalkana waxaan ahaa kii kaniisadda silciya, xagga xaqnimada sharcigana waxaan ahaa mid aan eed lahayn. Laakiin wax kasta oo aan u haystay faa'iido, waxaan u arkay khasaare Masiixa aawadiis. Waxaa intaas ka sii daran, waxaan wax kasta u arkaa khasaare aawadaa aqoonta sare ee Masiix Ciise oo Rabbigay ah.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Ha rayraysteen quluubta doonta Rabbiga. U heesa isaga, u gabyaya isaga, oo ka sheekeeya shuqulladiisa cajaa'ibka leh. Ku faana magaciisa quduuska ah; ha rayraysteen quluubta doonta Rabbiga! U fiirsada Rabbiga iyo xooggiisa; mar walba doona wejigiisa. Xusuusta shuqulladiisa cajaa'ibka leh ee uu sameeyey, calaamadahiisa, iyo xukummadiisa uu ku dhawaaqay. Idinku farcankii Ibraahim oo addoommadiisa ah, wiilashii Yacquub oo uu doortay! Isagu, Rabbiga, waa Ilaaheenna; xukummadiisu waxay ka dhex muuqdaan dhulka oo dhan.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Cashuur-qaadayaashii iyo dembiilayaashii oo dhami waxay u soo dhowaanayeen inay Ciise maqlaan, laakiin Fariisiyadii iyo culimadii sharciga ayaa ka cawday, iyagoo leh, 'Ninkani wuxuu soo dhoweeyaa dembiilayaasha, wuuna la cunaa.' Sidaas darteed Ciise wuxuu u soo jeediyey masaalkan: 'Nin idin ka mid ah oo leh boqol neef oo mid ka mid ah ka luma, miyuusan ka tagayn sagaashan iyo sagaalka saxaraha oo u raadinayn kii lumay ilaa uu ka helo? Markuu helo, wuxuu saarayaa garbaha isagoo faraxsan, markuu guriga yimaadana, wuxuu u yeerayaa saaxiibbadiis iyo deriskiis, wuxuuna ku leeyahay, 'Ila faraxa, waayo waxaan helay neefkaygii lumay.' Waxaan idinku leeyahay, si la mid ah, jannada waxaa ka jiri doona farxad ka weyn midda sagaashan iyo sagaalka qof ee xaqqa ah oo aan u baahnayn toobad keen, marka loo eego hal dembiile oo toobad keena. Ama naag haysata toban dinaar oo mid ka mid ah ka luma, miyaysan shidayn laambad oo xaaqayn guriga, oo raadinayn si taxaddar leh ilaa ay ka hesho? Markay hesho, waxay u yeeraysaa saaxiibbadeed iyo deriskeeda, waxayna ku leedahay, 'Ila faraxa, waayo waxaan helay dinaarkii iga lumay.' Sidaas oo kale, waxaan idinku leeyahay, waxaa jiri doona farxad dhex taal malaa'igaha Ilaah hal dembiile oo toobad keena.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
